description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Terminator Storm Force — DEATH BLOW (WP-M2b): friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR units have +1 to charge rolls. Fixture sm11e_m2b_marines_active (P1 Space Marines with the eight group-B detachments; the Terminator Squad is 9" from the Gretchin). Setup privileges: CP 0 for both players (no Command Re-roll / reactions — not under test), straight to the Charge phase.
